qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant global installed base in minerals processing (grinding mills, crushers, flotation cells) with 55%+ of revenue from proprietary aftermarket wear parts and field services providing high customer switching costs and pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (FCF Conversion). Dominant mining flowsheet and wear-parts supplier with resilient 16%+ median ROIC and high aftermarket exposure, but multi-year cash conversion is only ~60% of net income due to structural working capital absorption in inventories and project receivables across cyclical swings.
qualitative.evidence: While Metso boasts a 16.5% median GAAP ROIC and strong mineral processing market positions, 4-year cumulative Owner FCF (€951m) represents just 59.6% of GAAP Net Income (€1,596m), severely missing the 80% hurdle. Severe working capital drains in 2022-2023 (€376m and €449m) reflect heavy inventory and receivable cycles intrinsic to heavy mining equipment.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
